_about: Data that is generated, not committed. Each bundle is a GitHub release (tag) of this repo whose assets are the listed files; tools/fetch_bundle.py downloads them and checks size and SHA-256. A published tag never changes: new data gets a new tag (export side: scripts/export_public.py --bundle NAME --tag NAME=<tag> in the paper repo).
_repo: owner/name of this public repository on GitHub. Change it here (and in the README title) if the repository is renamed.
_hydroshare: TODO (author): archive each bundle as a HydroShare resource, then set its "hydroshare" to the resource's file base URL, e.g. https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/<resource id>/data/contents/ ; fetch_bundle.py then uses it as fallback (or with --source hydroshare).

explorer.about: Basin explorer web data (overview tiles + JSON); optional full-resolution tiles

network-stats.about: EPA/GNIS query snapshot read by repro/network_stats/domains.py
